title: Orbital Angular Momentum as a Transverse Probe of Elliptic Small-$x$ Gluon Tomography
summary: We propose a new way to probe elliptic small-$x$ gluon geometry in hard diffractive dijet deep inelastic scattering: a localized lepton wave packet carrying orbital angular momentum is used as a tunable transverse analyzer of the target. Unlike the conventional plane-wave setup, where the probe provides a fixed transverse projection, the OAM mode supplies additional radial and azimuthal structure while leaving the target dipole matrix element unchanged. We characterize the resulting elliptic response through $S_M=D_M-C_M$ and find finite-yield response nodes whose origin depends on the OAM…
